Email address

exceptions: An ETA does not guarantee admission. Each traveller, including children, needs their own permission unless exempt.
No ETA is needed when travelling on a British National (Overseas) passport, with a valid UK visa, or with qualifying UK immigration permission. British and Irish citizens are exempt.
Eligible non-visa nationals living in Ireland are exempt when entering from Ireland, Guernsey, Jersey or the Isle of Man; proof of Irish residence is required from age 16.
Visits can last up to six months. Only permitted visitor activities are allowed; living in the UK through repeated visits is prohibited.
An ETA may cover permitted business visits and short-term study; employment has separate restrictions and limited stated concessions.
The ETA expires after two years or when the linked passport expires, whichever comes first.

fields.accommodation_evidence: Provide the intended accommodation address and, where applicable, evidence of support from a sponsor. A hotel booking is not universally required.
